body.content: Open question: does §11.3 require a single critic failure (minimal falsification) or multiple independent failures (robustness through triangulation) to sustain a flag? The neighborhood data supports BOTH readings, so disambiguating the §11.3 text is the critical information need.
body.why_keep_this: Identifies the fork between candidate-1 (single datum sufficient) and candidate-6 (AND-gate) readings.
